sources.note: Auditory ba dubbed with visual ga, reported fused syllable; reversed dubbing yielded different responses.
Individual susceptibility variation; visual place-of-articulation extraction relationship; not general cognitive scores.

324 Mandarin-speaking twins, 9 stimuli, 150 retests, r=.55; 5.5% r-squared from combined co-twin correlation, NOT heritability. MZ/DZ correlations not significantly different; genetic/shared environment unseparated.

51 young adults: 17 English monolinguals, 18 early/16 late Korean-English bilinguals; both bilingual groups showed more fusion in QUIET only, not significantly different in NOISE; self-reported English proficiency; association not cause.
Intensive 3-month retreat, 17 self-selected retreat vs 23 briefly trained controls, nonrandom.
Attentional blink seven experiments, not seven conditions.
Two experiments underlying one FLoRA replication record; variability in timing, accuracy, lag-one.
Lists Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots; do not adopt its psychological outcomes.
Premium: 12 levels, 48 MP3, four styles and advertised one-year refund; page prices displayed but checkout and refunds unverified.
Total Focus 33 minutes and 47 MB; 14-day advertised seller refund; price and outcome claims not independently verified.
Lists Focus Shot, Brain Power Shot; does not prove branded efficacy or affiliate authorization.
Open affiliate application and advertised commission marketing, not a publisher-specific accepted account/issued earning URL.
Clear conspicuous near-link commission disclosure; 'affiliate link' alone may be unclear.
Product-relevant evidence required for objective health/psychological outcomes; no evidence inheritance.
52-page Seven Day Focus Fieldbook, sole existing newsletter funnel.
Single established Dispatch subscription; native authority determines confirmed leads.
Historical archive; direct web fetch intermittently unavailable, no independent live verification this sprint.
Historical 1784 commission editorial link; direct web fetch intermittently unavailable.
Published article reported by issue, no guarantee current URL response.
Editorial lane, release holds and issue coordination.
Traffic quality and conversion evidence contract.
A/B text only vs optional 42-second unrendered concept; disabled controls.
Praxxis requested Slagter nonrandom group details, seven experiments, replication nuances; corrections applied R197.

claims.assertion: Audio ba paired with visual ga in original experiment
claims.limitations: Only particular recording and stimuli.

claims.assertion: Some observers reported fused da with mismatch
claims.limitations: Not all people or syllables.

claims.assertion: Reverse mismatch yielded different compound reports
claims.limitations: Do not simplify as the same da on both pairings.

claims.assertion: Physical soundtrack does not change when reported syllable changes
claims.limitations: Requires controls to establish physically recorded source.

claims.assertion: Large interindividual McGurk susceptibility variance
claims.limitations: Cannot diagnose cognition.

claims.assertion: Visual articulation extraction related to susceptibility
claims.limitations: Correlational, not causal training effect.

claims.assertion: No reported relation to tested attention, WM, speed measures
claims.limitations: Not a broad proof that cognition never matters.

claims.assertion: 324 twins, 9 stimuli, 150 retested
claims.limitations: Native Mandarin-speaking cohort.

claims.assertion: Two-year retest correlation r=0.55
claims.limitations: Subset; no universal stability.

claims.assertion: Combined co-twin correlation r-squared ≈5.5%; not heritability
claims.limitations: MZ and DZ correlations did not significantly differ; genes and shared environment not separable.

claims.assertion: Korean-English bilingual groups reported more fusion than English monolinguals in QUIET, no significant group difference in NOISE
claims.limitations: 51 young adults; self-reported English proficiency; noncausal result.

claims.assertion: McGurk susceptibility is not a test of superior focus or mental health
claims.limitations: Avoid implied health or cognitive diagnosis.

claims.assertion: 17 self-selected experienced retreat vs 23 brief-practice controls
claims.limitations: 3-month, 10-12h/day; NONrandom.

claims.assertion: Reduced AB in retreat vs control related to P3b measure
claims.limitations: Not a Zen12 efficacy trial.

claims.assertion: Chun and Potter reported seven experiments
claims.limitations: Corrects inherited 'seven experimental conditions'.

claims.assertion: FLoRA's one record references two replication experiments
claims.limitations: Avoid blanket failure or success claims.

claims.assertion: Inspire3 lists several mind-audio offers
